entry.title: Monday 26 October 2026 · weekly: 1 to read, 19 worth the title
entry.content:
Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 72 E Trapped-ion-based quantum repeater node across a 17 km metropolitan fiber
    K. Fabitha, T. Runggaldier, A. Winkler et al. · 2026-10-20
    Two ions in one cavity act as a repeater node, linking photons across 17 km of city fiber at 81.6% Bell-state fidelity.
  • 70 T High-fidelity entanglement of two spectrally-distinct solid state emitters
    Daniel R. E. Hodgson, Pieter Kok · 2026-10-22
    Feeding entangled photon pairs into two mismatched quantum dots entangles them at concurrence 0.95 despite different frequencies and linewidths.
  • 62 E Photon-Number Discrimination from Increasing Time-of-Arrival Separation in Wide Superconducting Microstrip Single-Photon Detectors
    Hsin-Yeh Wu, Shu-Xiao Liu, Boris Tuchming et al. · 2026-10-23
    Wide NbN microstrip detectors resolve up to eight photons from arrival-time shifts alone, with neighbouring peaks separating better at higher number.
  • 60 E All-photonic millimeter-wave and terahertz signal core at room and cryogenic temperatures
    Jiawen Liu, Chengli Wang, Aleksei Gaier et al. · 2026-10-22
    A lithium tantalate chip generates, modulates and detects 0.1–2.5 THz signals through fibre only, and still works at 4 K.
  • 58 T Polarization-encoded photon statistics for counting dipole emitters
    Oumeng Zhang · 2026-10-23
    Polarized excitation and four-channel detection let photon statistics count overlapping emitters with up to 4.8 times fewer pulses.
  • 55 E Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics
    Alexander Jung, Anastasiia Ciers, Hannes Pfeifer et al. · 2026-10-22
    Nanopillar metasurface on a thin membrane reaches 99.82% reflectivity while hosting a mechanical mode with Q·f of 2×10^14 Hz.
  • 55 T Attosecond Quantum Optical Spectroscopy of Topological Materials
    C. Granados, J. Rivera-Dean, D. Kim et al. · 2026-10-20
    Harmonics driven by quantum light carry intensity correlations that flip sign with the Chern number, absent from the mean spectrum.
  • 54 T Photon localization: Local measurements, localized states, and causality
    Jan Gulla, Johannes Skaar · 2026-10-21
    Review argues localization must be defined by local measurements: single photons cannot be strictly localized, coherent states can.
  • 52 T Time-reversal-based quantum metrology in a central-spin architecture: from SATIN to butterfly echo
    Aditya Kumar, Sayan Choudhury · 2026-10-22
    A central spin mediating a star-shaped bath implements SATIN and butterfly echoes reaching Heisenberg-scaled sensing for any unknown axis.
  • 52 T \textit{In situ} certification of multiparticle indistinguishability in a generic interferometer
    Valery Shchesnovich · 2026-10-18
    Bunching statistics in any random interferometer certify multiphoton indistinguishability with polynomial runs, even under uniform loss.
  • 50 T Moments of Random Permanents and Hafnians: A Replica Approach
    Paolo Facchi, Angelo Mariano, Giorgio Parisi et al. · 2026-10-20
    Replica calculation gives closed-form growth rates and corrections for moments of random permanents and hafnians, relevant to boson sampling.
  • 50 TE Single-photon time qubit: Quantum-vacuum control and complementarity of the arrow of time
    Tai Hyun Yoon · 2026-10-20
    Phase inversion in seeded biphoton sources flips the stimulated evolution, giving a controllable two-level 'time qubit' with a complementarity law.
  • 50 E Allight: A Perfect Photon Collector
    Dan Porat, Ran Finkelstein, Tal Carmon · 2026-10-19
    Inverse-designed dielectric enclosure collects emission from the full 4π solid angle into one beam; ray bending demonstrated only in 2D.

Foundations of quantum mechanics

  • 80 T Finite Nonsignalling Resources Suffice to Simulate Entangled Qubits
    Ziao Tang, Xin Wang, Ge Bai · 2026-10-23
    Every pure two-qubit state's projective statistics are exactly simulated with finitely many PR boxes, at most 128·cot⁴θ calls.
  • 78 T What does quantum parameter estimation estimate? A no-go result for true quantity values
    Jacques L. Pienaar, Eran Tal, Asya Ciftci · 2026-10-22
    No-go theorem: a unique pre-existing 'true value' in quantum estimation is incompatible with complete states plus probe–system entanglement.
  • 66 T Interacting quantum reference frames
    Leonardo Chataignier, Alexander R. H. Smith · 2026-10-20
    Frame changes stay unitary even with interacting reference frames, recovering a unitary clock-system Schrödinger equation.
  • 62 T Conservation in Every Quantum Measurement Outcome?
    E. Okon, D. Sudarsky, M. Wiedemann · 2026-10-21
    Critique shows the proposed outcome-by-outcome conservation via correlated preparers is unjustified and does not deliver what it claims.
  • 58 T Mutual Information Across Quantum Reference Frame Perspectives
    Leonardo Valente, Carla Ferradini, Flaminia Giacomini et al. · 2026-10-22
    Defines mutual information between subsystems seen from different quantum reference frames, correcting overcounting via a modified chain rule.
  • 55 T The Four-Qubit Hyperbolic Quadric Has Contextuality Degree 315
    Zhengyu Li, Amandeep Gupta, Vijay Ganesh · 2026-10-19
    Proves the four-qubit hyperbolic quadric has contextuality degree 315, with a hand proof plus Lean and DRAT certificates.

Superconducting quantum computing

  • 62 T Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
    Kerem Yurtseven, Shantanu R. Jha, Apoorva Limaye et al. · 2026-10-20
    Simulated ATS coupler gives a 50 ns bias-preserving CX between Kerr cats at 99.69% fidelity and noise bias near 10^4.

entry.title: Monday 19 October 2026 · weekly: 8 to read, 35 worth the title
entry.content:
Superconducting artificial atoms

  • 90 E Deterministic and Programmable Fusion for Scalable Generation of Photonic Graph States
    Yan Li, Yunfan Yang, Zenghui Bao et al. · 2026-10-14
    Bell-state projection of flying microwave photons fuses on-demand time-bin cluster states deterministically, reaching genuine 13-photon entanglement with emitter reset and reuse.
  • 84 E Collective Floquet engineering between two distant superconducting artificial atoms
    Y. -H. Huang, Jiale Yuan, Z. Q. Niu et al. · 2026-10-12
    A flux drive turns the waveguide-mediated exchange and collective decay between two distant transmons into tunable, on-demand quantities instead of geometry-fixed ones.
  • 72 E Deterministic and programmable generation of mechanical multipartite entangled states
    Isabelle Franzen, Max-Emanuel Kern, Q. Rumman Rahman et al. · 2026-10-13
    Optimal-control isometries from a transmon write W, GHZ and cluster states across up to four bulk-acoustic phonon modes, then use them to bound correlated dephasing.
  • 68 E Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
    Finn Müßigbrodt, Andraž Omahen, Q. Rumman Rahman et al. · 2026-10-13
    Phonon Fock states up to seven quanta give a 7 dB phase-insensitive sensitivity gain in a microgram acoustic resonator, with a neural-network estimator matching it.
  • 62 T Broadening the reflection band of atomic mirrors by engineering the emitter-waveguide coupling
    C. -Y. Lee, G. -D. Lin, H. H. Jen et al. · 2026-10-13
    A Gaussian profile of emitter-waveguide couplings widens the reflection band of a finite atomic mirror and kills its Fabry-Perot ripples, with a 1/N bandwidth law.
  • 60 E Cavity-assisted dynamic nuclear polarisation
    Tristan Lorriaux, Yutian Wen, Patrice Bertet et al. · 2026-10-13
    Purcell-enhanced spin relaxation into a superconducting resonator drives nuclear polarisation of bismuth donors, reaching 4.6-fold enhancement at millikelvin temperatures.
  • 55 T Mechanical trisqueezing in circuit quantum acoustodynamics with SNAIL devices
    Yi-Zhou Bu, Matteo Fadel, Kai Xu et al. · 2026-10-14
    A SNAIL's cubic nonlinearity with flux pumping yields a three-phonon trisqueezing Hamiltonian for a bulk acoustic resonator, with realistic coupling estimates.
  • 50 E Quantum-enhanced Search for Galactic Dark Photons Using Cat-State Cavities
    Aoying Wang, Yanjie Zeng, Yanyan Cai et al. · 2026-10-14
    Re-analysing cat-state parity data from a cavity dark-photon search sets diurnal-modulation bounds on a relativistic Galactic dark-photon background.

Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 86 E A Rydberg atom array coupled to a high-cooperativity optical cavity
    Tai Xiang, Yue-Hui Lu, Tsai-Chen Lee et al. · 2026-10-14
    Rydberg blockade switches two atoms between superradiant collective scattering and single-atom scattering into a high-cooperativity cavity, plus 7.5 us Purcell readout.
  • 74 T Crossovers between Time-Bin and Energy-Time Entanglement in Homodyned Resonance Fluorescence
    Zi-Qi Zeng, Jian Wang, Bang Wu et al. · 2026-10-15
    Homodyning resonance fluorescence with a phase-locked laser tunes the photon pair entanglement from time-bin to energy-time and back, verified via Franson CHSH.
  • 70 E Experimental observation of Higgs oscillations and their power-law decay across pairing regimes in a cavity QED quantum simulator
    Chitose Maruko, Haoqing Zhang, Eliot A. Bohr et al. · 2026-10-09
    Floquet-dressed atoms in a cavity emulate BCS-to-BEC pairing and show Higgs oscillations decaying as a power law with exponent 0.65 in the weak-pairing regime.
  • 64 T Remote Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Entanglement Generation between Trapped Ions
    Haruki Aoki, Kazufumi Tanji, Shohei Kiryu et al. · 2026-10-15
    A heralded photonic protocol entangles GKP qubits stored in the motion of distant trapped ions, with over 95% logical Bell-pair fidelity under realistic losses.
  • 62 T Ghost unitaries for loss-resilient photonic resource-state generation
    Kevin J. Randles, Manuel H. Muñoz-Arias, Kevin Thompson · 2026-10-12
    Applying the interferometer to the heralding arms of squeezed sources converts loss into rare false heralds, raising resource-state fidelity; direct GHZ outputs are uniformly damped.
  • 58 T Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
    Maciej Chudak, Massimiliano Esposito, Krzysztof Ptaszynski · 2026-10-15
    Quantum instanton numerics predict switching rates, stationary magnetisation and first-order transitions in cooperative resonance fluorescence, matching master-equation results.
  • 58 T Time-Frequency Continuous-Variable Quantum Teleportation with Single Photons
    Mohamed Meguebel, Nadia Belabas, Nicolas Fabre · 2026-10-12
    Continuous-variable teleportation in single-photon time-frequency needs detector-position correction; time-frequency cat and GKP states give fidelity revivals for synchronisation.
  • 55 E Preservation of photon statistics upon selective molecular modulation in hollow-core fibers
    Arturo Mena, Pau Arcos, María Sánchez-Hernández et al. · 2026-10-14
    Raman molecular modulation in hydrogen-filled hollow-core fibre converts weak 585 nm light to 773 and 471 nm with near-unity efficiency, preserving photon statistics.
  • 52 T Nonperturbative optomechanics with thin, weakly reflective intracavity dielectrics
    Andrew Laeuger, Nancy Aggarwal · 2026-10-11
    A thin dielectric plate spanning the whole cavity mode splits it into coupled subcavities; perturbative coupling formulas fail already at lambda over 10n thickness.
  • 50 T Single and coupled quantum van der Pol oscillators: Wigner-function dynamics, exact qutrit solutions, and synchronization
    Rohitashwa Chattopadhyay, Vinayak Pendse, Shamik Gupta · 2026-10-14
    Exact qutrit solutions and a stochastic Wigner method describe quantum van der Pol limit cycles; strong nonlinear dissipation shrinks the synchronisation region.

Foundations of quantum mechanics

  • 84 T Bell's go theorem: regaining local causality with a new notion of realism
    Lorenzo Catani, Nesta van der Schaaf, Rui Soares Barbosa · 2026-10-12
    Replacing points of an ontic space with point-free records on a locale yields locally causal, non-conspiratorial models reaching any CHSH value.
  • 80 T Bell scenarios encode classical non-causality
    Andreas Leitherer, Kyrylo Simonov, Ravi Kunjwal et al. · 2026-10-16
    The measurements of composite Bell scenarios are exactly the classical process functions, giving a graphical criterion for non-causal ones.
  • 74 T On the relationship between the POVM framework and the no-signaling hypothesis
    Will Cavendish · 2026-10-16
    Under the standard composite-system representation and two textbook marginal claims, the no-signaling hypothesis is equivalent to universality of POVMs.
  • 62 T Schrödinger's unpublished hidden-variable model in the 1944-45 debate over the "Collapse of Determinism"
    Flavio Del Santo · 2026-10-14
    An unpublished 1944-45 Schrödinger manuscript gives an explicit hidden-variable model, transcribed and analysed for the first time.
  • 60 T Operational Limits of Gravity-Mediated Entanglement
    Atta ur Rahman, Muhammad Noman, Ying-Jian Zhu et al. · 2026-10-15
    Finite wave-packet width and dephasing shrink the windows where gravity-mediated entangled states are Bell-nonlocal; residual electrostatics can cancel the gravitational phase.
  • 58 T Quantum Reference Frames in terms of Tetrads
    Jeremy Butterfield, Daniel A. Turolla Vanzella · 2026-10-12
    Quantum reference frames are modelled as amplitudes over tetrads on frame bundles, allowing superpositions of perspectives on superposed geometries.
  • 50 T Emergent Non-Biorthogonal Born Rule at Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
    Wei-Wei Yang, Henning Schomerus, Jiangping Hu et al. · 2026-10-13
    Generalising dynamical quantum phase transitions to subspaces gives left and right non-Hermitian eigenstates a direct Born-rule probabilistic meaning.

Superconducting quantum computing

  • 88 TE Stitched surface codes: planar concatenation through GHZ corridors
    Mohamed A. Shalby, Alexandre Bourassa, Amir Karamlou et al. · 2026-10-15
    Concatenating four surface-code patches with a [[4,2,2]] code via GHZ corridors runs on 105-qubit Willow, cutting logical error 1.52x from distance 4 to 6.
  • 82 E Superconducting circuits host two-level systems with lifetimes exceeding one second
    Mathieu Féchant, Phillip Lenhard, Nicolas Gosling et al. · 2026-10-15
    Quantum-jump correlation spectroscopy finds TLS defects coupled at kilohertz to transmons whose intrinsic lifetimes exceed one second.
  • 80 E Selective Control and Imaging of Higgs and Goldstone Modes with a Quantum Simulator
    Connie Miao, Pranjal Praneel, Thomas G. Kiely et al. · 2026-10-13
    Google's transmon Bose-Hubbard array selectively excites and images Higgs and Goldstone modes, with finite size keeping the Higgs mode coherent.
  • 78 T Photon-stimulated decay of $χ$-matched ancillas causes unheralded bit flips in bosonic codes
    Aleksandr Gulkanov · 2026-10-12
    Code photons open a first-order unheralded f-to-g Raman decay of chi-matched ancillas, predicting bit-flip floors in Ocelot-style cat codes growing linearly with cat size.
  • 76 E Measuring higher-order bulk topology in a programmable quantum simulator
    Pratik Sathe, Niclas Heinsdorf, Majid Kheirkhah et al. · 2026-10-12
    Up to 728 qubits of an analogue-digital annealer realise 1D-3D higher-order topological insulators and extract a 3D octupole moment via nested Wilson loops.
  • 70 E Experimental Realization of a C-Shunt Flux-Qubit Coupler for Controlled-Z Gates between Transmons
    Weiping Yuan, Silu Zhao, Li Li et al. · 2026-10-13
    A C-shunt flux-qubit coupler gives near-zero idle ZZ and a 45 ns CZ at 99.23% fidelity between transmons, limited by coupler T1.
  • 66 TE ZZ-Free bSWAP Gates under Strong Driving in Far-Detuned Fixed-Frequency Transmons
    Akinori Machino, Kazuhisa Ogawa, Yuto Ikegai et al. · 2026-10-15
    Strong single-tone driving of far-detuned fixed-frequency transmons yields a 150 ns sqrt-bSWAP with tunable ZZ, beating cross-resonance for SWAP and showing two-spin squeezing.
  • 65 E Syndrome-Resolved Decoding of Qubit Readout Errors
    Han Zheng, Vladimir Pešić, Nikolay Gusarov et al. · 2026-10-14
    A readout error decoder turns repeated thresholded records into a channel-resolved budget of misassignment, bit flips and leakage on fluxonium and transmon.
  • 62 E Accurate gap control of 3D-integrated superconducting quantum circuits using asymmetric indium architecture and multi-angle flip-chip bonding
    L. Richard, N. Bruckmoser, J. Feigl et al. · 2026-10-15
    Thick indium bumps on one chip and thin pads on the other, plus multi-angle compression, give 20 microrad flip-chip tilt with T1 near 160 us.
  • 62 T Architecting Instruction Execution for Scalable Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
    Dmitry Filippov, Justin Hogaboam, Mathias Soeken et al. · 2026-10-12
    Microsoft's cycle-accurate study finds a local-logical-operation instruction set is the only level that fits cryogenic power budgets and realistic routing for FTQC.
  • 60 E A low-cost compact muon detector for millikelvin operation
    Tengiz Ibrayev, Danish Khan, Alex Herscovics et al. · 2026-10-14
    A cheap in-cryostat scintillator muon tagger works to 10 mK and reveals unexplained double pulses tied to a superconducting layer in the SiPM.
  • 60 TE Leakage benchmarking with decohering subgroups in the presence of preparation and measurement errors
    Shawn Geller, Tongyu Zhao, Alex Kwiatkowski et al. · 2026-10-13
    Randomized benchmarking with leakage is recast as a Markov process with noisy classical SPAM, yielding SPAM-robust confidence intervals for leakage and fidelity.
  • 58 E Experimental Demonstration of a Balanced Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifier
    Nikita Klimovich, Peter K. Day, Henry G. Leduc et al. · 2026-10-16
    Two kinetic-inductance TWPAs between 180-degree hybrids give 20 dB gain over nearly an octave with -15 dB image rejection, doubling usable bandwidth.
  • 58 E Local error correction prolongs time-crystalline memory
    Benedikt Fauseweh · 2026-10-13
    Repetition-code bit-flip correction on up to 68 qubits doubles discrete time-crystal memory lifetime; syndrome measurement without correction shortens it.
  • 55 T Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
    Ciro Salcedo, Sasha Cocquyt, Andrew Osborne et al. · 2026-10-15
    A flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism handles nonlinear gyrator circuits and moves Josephson elements across gyrators while preserving the spectrum.
  • 55 T Transmission representation of the Josephson free energy beyond the short-junction limit
    Anton R. Akhmerov · 2026-10-13
    Beenakker's transmission formula is generalised beyond short junctions, bounding the quartic-to-quadratic ratio and disproving a conjecture, all verified in Lean.
  • 55 T Bosonic unstructured search: quantum enhancement without entanglement
    Yu-Xin Wang, Erfan Abbasgholinejad, Supratik Sarkar et al. · 2026-10-12
    Optimal bosonic unstructured search scales with mean boson number; non-Gaussianity is necessary but entanglement is not, with matching lower bounds under loss.
  • 55 E Avoiding Defects within Heavy-Hexagon Architecture
    Hansol Kim, Younghun Kwon · 2026-10-10
    A two-cycle super-stabilizer scheme avoids defective qubits on heavy-hex lattices, cutting logical error per cycle by about 10% on IBM hardware.

entry.title: Monday 12 October 2026 · weekly: 9 to read, 26 worth the title
entry.content:
Superconducting artificial atoms

  • 88 E Arbitrary-phase CZ gate and remote readout across spatially separated superconducting nodes
    Anatoly Kulikov, Josua D. Schär, Alonso Hernández-Antón et al. · 2026-10-04
    Two qubits in separate cryostats 30 m apart get a tunable-phase CZ gate from one reflected microwave photon; remote readout needs no remote-side action.
  • 82 E Quantum jumps of sound
    Takuma Makihara, Erik Szakiel, Matthew P. Maksymowych et al. · 2026-10-07
    A transmon makes repeated QND phonon-number measurements of a 2 ms nanomechanical resonator, heralding single phonons at 85% and catching quantum jumps.
  • 66 T Stimulated emission for a three-level artificial atom in waveguide quantum electrodynamics
    O. A. Chuikin, Ya. S. Greenberg, V. V. Taravkova et al. · 2026-10-07
    For transmon-like low anharmonicity, the third level suppresses stimulated emission of a single-photon pulse in an open waveguide but can create reflected-photon bunching.
  • 50 T Latent Symmetry in Quantum Zeno Dynamics
    Stefano Longhi · 2026-10-08
    A latent symmetry in a monitored resonator network makes two geometrically different Zeno subspaces have exactly identical escape and residence statistics.

Quantum optics on other platforms

  • 82 E Quantum Networking at the Speed of Quantum Computation: Kilohertz Entanglement in a Heterogeneous Quantum System
    Lukas Hartung, Pierre Barral, Noah Glachman et al. · 2026-10-07
    Trapped Ba ion and diamond SiV entangled via one converted, reflected photon at 1.03 kHz and 88% fidelity, four times the best ion-ion link.
  • 80 E Deterministic generation of large-scale photonic GHZ states utilizing spin echo in a solid-state quantum light source
    Zu-En Su, Dan Cogan, Oded Kenneth et al. · 2026-10-08
    A quantum dot emits GHZ states of more than a dozen photons at GHz rates, using natural electron-hole spin precession as a built-in spin echo.
  • 64 T Perfect Bound States and non-Markovian Dynamics for Imperfect Giant Atoms in a Semi-Infinite Waveguide
    T. Y. Liu, X. Y. Li, W. Y. Hu et al. · 2026-10-06
    For an imperfect giant atom in a semi-infinite waveguide, retuning restores exact bound states after strength or position errors but never after phase errors.
  • 62 E A programmable quantum photonic platform integrating coherent emitters
    Hanna Salamon, Mikkel T. Mikkelsen, Zhe Liu et al. · 2026-10-05
    Lodahl's team runs coherent quantum-dot emitters and reconfigurable cryogenic optics on one chip, showing two-photon interference concurrently.
  • 60 T Extensively degenerate superradiant phase in a giant-atom quantum Rabi ring
    Shu He, Li-Wei Duan · 2026-10-07
    Giant-atom quantum Rabi ring has 2^N degenerate superradiant states; quantum fluctuations select ferro- or antiferro-superradiant order.
  • 58 T Quantum-optimized phase closure for robust interferometric imaging
    Zhenning Liu, Emil T. Khabiboulline, Lorcan O. Conlon et al. · 2026-10-05
    Joint three-photon measurements estimate closure phases with photon cost scaling linearly in telescope number instead of quadratically.
  • 52 T Dissipation-selected photon-phonon pair and photon-bundle emission in a tripartite Mollow system
    Jiayuan Zhang, Geng Zhao, Jing Tang et al. · 2026-10-07
    Symmetry of dissipation channels selects between photon-phonon pair bundles and pure photon bundles in a driven tripartite Mollow system.
  • 50 T Path Complementarity Enables Directional Quantum Light in Hybridized Cavity Polaritons
    Jing Tang, Yuangang Deng · 2026-10-07
    Zeeman-split ring cavity with backscattering gives direction-dependent photon blockade while keeping single-photon path entanglement.

Foundations of quantum mechanics

  • 82 T Redundant Records of the Past: Unifying Quantum Darwinism and Decoherent Histories
    Philipp Strasberg · 2026-10-07
    Strasberg merges quantum Darwinism and decoherent histories via redundant records of past events, finding redundancy far more generic than Darwinism suggests.
  • 80 T A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
    Olumakinde Ogunnaike · 2026-10-09
    Replacing the Born rule exponent 2 by 2b makes repeated measurements act as a Maxwell's demon for b>1 and create hyperuniform gases for b<1.
  • 78 T No-Disturbance-without-Uncertainty generates the Quantum set in the simplest Bell scenario
    Ravishankar Ramanathan · 2026-10-06
    A no-disturbance-without-uncertainty condition plus no-signalling exactly reproduces the quantum set in the simplest Bell scenarios, marginals included.
  • 76 T A Flash-Based Relativistic Collapse Model for Quantum Fields
    Nicolò Piccione · 2026-10-07
    Flash-based relativistic collapse model for quantum fields with foliation independence, no-signalling and finite energy production, at the cost of a new state space.
  • 70 T Bell nonlocality does not imply violation of nonlocal games
    Ricardo Faleiro, Lucas E. A. Porto, Marco Túlio Quintino et al. · 2026-10-05
    Proves nonlocal games with deterministic predicates cannot witness all Bell nonlocality, and quantum states produce such game-classical nonlocal behaviour.
  • 60 T Operational quasiprobability formulation of non-signaling in time for macrorealism violations
    Stefano Gherardini, Paolo Solinas · 2026-10-06
    Quasi-non-signalling in time defines a quasiprobability macrorealism test strictly stronger than NSIT, equivalent for qubits.
  • 60 T Foundational puzzles on quantum universality: From Wigner's friend to black holes
    Laurens Walleghem · 2026-10-02
    Thesis: refined Frauchiger-Renner, contextuality-based Wigner's-friend arguments, a PBR argument against absolute free choice, and black-hole links.
  • 55 T Quantum Darwinism through apparatus-mediated environmental recording
    Tran P. H Don, Lan Nguyen Tran, Le Bin Ho · 2026-10-06
    Quantum Darwinism records can form through an intermediate apparatus; apparatus bit flips cap recoverable information even from the whole environment.
  • 52 T Minimal Scenarios Witnessing Genuine Multipartite Nonlocality Possibilistically
    Soumyadip Patra, Peter Bierhorst · 2026-10-08
    Inflation shows a five-party possibilistic game separates quantum strategies from bipartite-resource LOSR models robustly.
  • 50 T Bounding Two-Way Average Communication Cost of Simulating Quantum Correlations
    Kai-Siang Chen, Gelo Noel M. Tabia, Bo-An Tsai et al. · 2026-10-03
    Nonlocal games bound average two-way communication needed to simulate quantum correlations; n Magic Square copies need n log2(3/2) bits.

Superconducting quantum computing

  • 88 E Error-Corrected Memory and Logic on a Heavy-Hex Superconducting-Qubit Processor
    Campbell K. McLauchlan, Georgia M. Nixon, Julien M. Drouet et al. · 2026-10-08
    IBM runs a dynamic compass code on all 156 heavy-hex qubits, excluding bad components, and does lattice-surgery logic with Bell fidelity above 97% post-selected.
  • 84 E Dynamically protected erasure qubit via low-frequency charge driving
    Ahmed Hajr, Ke Wang, Bingcheng Qing et al. · 2026-10-07
    Sub-GHz charge driving of transmon-regime Kerr oscillators gives 82 ns reset and a dual-rail erasure qubit with 1.5e-4 error per Clifford post-selected.
  • 80 T Protecting bosonic codes from ancilla-induced errors with continuous-variable flags
    Thomas Décultot, Ronan Gautier, Mazyar Mirrahimi · 2026-10-05
    Mirrahimi's group adds an auxiliary oscillator 'flag' that records ancilla-decay errors in phase space, predicting 1000x fewer cat-parity logical errors.
  • 76 E Sub-MHz SWAP spectroscopy of two-level systems in superconducting qubits
    Joaquin Minguzzi, John Clai Owens, Oskar Painter et al. · 2026-10-08
    A flux-off-during-delay SWAP sequence resolves TLS Rabi chevrons at 0.1 MHz coupling, revealing coherent defects with 10 µs T1 previously deemed incoherent.
  • ★ 72 E A quasiparticle-protected superconducting qubit
    Trond Hjerpekjøn Haug, Johan Kolvik, Joey Frey et al. · 2026-10-08 · watchlist: Per Delsing
    A gold-on-niobium transmon with gap-engineered Al junctions tolerates 10x more near-infrared light before relaxation rises, with no quasiparticle frequency shift.
  • 72 E Quantitative Rules for Parallel Calibration and Drift-Resilient Maintenance of Large-Scale Superconducting Quantum Processors
    Zhihao Wu, Kechengqi Zhu, Shichuan Xue et al. · 2026-10-08
    On 66- and 337-qubit processors, measured rules set safe CZ-calibration concurrency (coupler distance four) and drift refresh priority, halving mean 1Q error.
  • 68 E Epitaxial NbN-junction-based self-shunted superconducting flux qubit with high anharmonicity
    Tokunoshin Uchida, Shingo Nozaki, Daiki Kurihara et al. · 2026-10-04
    An all-epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN self-shunted flux qubit reaches 797 MHz anharmonicity in a tiny footprint with T1 of 13-25 µs.
  • 60 TE Quickly extracting fidelity decay rates in random circuit benchmarking experiments
    Ake Köhne, Stavros Efthymiou, Joanna Majsak et al. · 2026-10-08
    A trace-filter estimator removes transients in structured randomized benchmarking, giving fidelity estimates below 10 layers on a 12-qubit Rigetti device.
  • 58 T Physical Design Automation for Planar Superconducting Quantum Chips
    Michael Feldmeier, Marcel Walter, Gerhard B. P. Huber et al. · 2026-10-06
    Open-source MQT tool lays out manufacturing-ready planar superconducting chips automatically in minutes, up to 25x faster than prior automation.
  • 55 E Sidewall spacer passivated epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN Josephson junctions for superconducting qubit applications
    Koki Honda, Daiki Kurihara, Hiroki Kutsuma et al. · 2026-10-04
    Sidewall-spacer passivated epitaxial NbN/AlN/NbN junctions span Jc from 0.3 to 1e4 A/cm² with low leakage and less amorphous dielectric.
  • 54 T Analog quantum simulation of $φ^4$ field theory with a superconducting transmission line
    Ilan T. Rosen, Neill C. Warrington, Max Hays et al. · 2026-10-08
